facility_roles.note: Placed on the SNOLAB site. The 2002 detectors sat in the water purification gallery of the SNO underground facility (arXiv:hep-ex/0312049); SNOLAB is the expanded laboratory at the same mine. In October to December 2010 the set-up moved to a 'Ladder Lab' at SNOLAB (official news page), which no paper names as a separate hall.
facility_roles.quote: In July 2002, a new phase of the project started. A batch of six 1-liter detectors with an active mass of approximately 40g was installed in a gallery of the SNO observatory in Sudbury

intervals.note: Start: July 2002, six 1-litre modules installed in a gallery of the SNO observatory (the paper's text says they took data in the water purification gallery); preliminary runs at the Picasso Lab in Montreal came earlier and are undated. End: the final paper says data taking with the upgraded 32-module set concluded in January 2014 (arXiv:1611.01499, Sec. 3). The detectors were moved to a new location (a 'Ladder Lab') at SNOLAB in October to December 2010 (official news page).

Depth: the 2003, 2005 and 2009 papers give 2070 m (the 2003 paper also 6,800 feet) for the SNO / SNOLAB location.

summary.plain: PICASSO searched for dark matter with many tiny droplets of a fluorine-rich liquid held in a gel about two kilometres underground at SNOLAB in Canada. A particle hitting a droplet can turn it into a bubble that sensors hear. It set limits on spin-dependent WIMP-proton interactions, and its team merged with COUPP to form PICO.
summary.technical: Superheated-droplet dark matter search (Project In CAnada to Search for Supersymmetric Objects) at SNOLAB, 2070 m depth. Modules hold C4F10 droplets (average diameter 200 um) in a polyacrylamide gel; piezoelectric transducers record the acoustic signal and localise events, and the energy threshold is set by the operating temperature (1-60 keV). Final data set: 32 modules, 3.0 kg of C4F10, 231.4 kg d between March 2012 and January 2014; spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit 1.32e-2 pb (90% CL) at 20 GeV/c^2 (abstract of arXiv:1611.01499).
